instructions.title: Prepare your own disc
instructions.instruction: A permitted existing Linux copy requires Parasite Eve USA SLUS-00662 Disc 1 as the raw BIN/CUE set; the documented Disc 1 BIN is 495531120 bytes. Keep all referenced tracks together. ISO and CHD are not direct equivalents. Newer native-only builds also describe Disc 2 support; use the selected release instructions rather than treating the old Day 1 build as the current runtime.

instructions.title: Keep the upstream launcher and profile
instructions.instruction: For an existing copy you are permitted to use, launch its parasite-eve wrapper with your disc folder, BIN or CUE using the selected release guide. The wrapper can remember disc1 in ~/.config/parasite-eve-port/config; the documented card is ~/.local/share/parasite-eve-port/memcard1.mcd. Preserve any customized XDG profile. Keep using the OS shortcut when the wrapper is required; Portcove does not register a shell script or assume its private binary has equivalent arguments. No files are adopted or replaced.

instructions.title: Prepare the reviewed original files
instructions.instruction: The published r5 route requires Xenogears USA SLUS-00664 Disc 1 as a 718738272-byte raw BIN plus SLUS_006.64, field.bin, menu.bin, shop_menu.bin, member_change_menu.bin and world_map.bin extracted from your own disc. An ISO is not equivalent. Follow the upstream extraction guide; no extractor is run by discovery and the runtime checks missing or different files.

instructions.title: Use the existing upstream launcher
instructions.instruction: For an existing copy you are permitted to use, run xenogears.sh with the prepared data folder on the first start; it remembers the folder. Keep its lib directory and OS launcher because the wrapper supplies the library environment. Preserve ~/.config/xenogears-port and ~/.local/share/xenogears-port (or the selected XDG locations), including cards and quick checkpoints. Portcove does not register the shell script, adopt files or replace this runtime.
